title: Tribrach feedback report, version 1
description: What an app attaches when a user says 'this is wrong'. States and operations are the model's own JSON; everything else is fixed here.

model.description: The model version the app was built against.

stamp.description: The model stamp, when the app records it.

service.description: Where the report arrived, such as github-issue-form.

ref.description: The ticket, issue or event id at that service.

privacy.description: Privacy labels of the fields included, as shown to the user before sending.
